summary: Ran a fresh isolated Google Chrome context against https://autopilot.local/zamowienie/ without submitting any form. Verified the native POST login form and required username/password controls, toggled and reset the remember-me checkbox, opened the registration dialog and closed it with Escape with focus restoration, and followed the password-recovery and guest-continuation links. No page or console errors were observed. The authenticated login outcome was not submitted because no genuine authorized account credentials were provided.
issues: CHK-INT-LOGIN-001 | critical | guest continuation behavior | Expected: selecting 'Kontynuuj jako gość' advances the isolated checkout session past the login/account-choice step to the delivery and payment step without placing an order. Actual: its href is the current /zamowienie/ URL; after a real click and navigation the final URL remains /zamowienie/, checkout-login-options is still visible, and advancedPastLoginStep is false. Fix: wire the control to a native WooCommerce guest-checkout transition that establishes the intended checkout state and displays the next step; keep order/payment submission outside this action.
